prompt: Combine the strongest features of two rare items into one item and keep it rare because each feature was already rare.
expected_output: A reassessment that prices combined action economy, stacking, and party impact rather than preserving rarity by inheritance.

assertions.text: Rejects the assumption that two rare ceilings remain rare when combined
Chooses a trade: remove a feature, narrow scope, add cost, raise tier, or add a meaningful limit
Runs a whole-item comparator and abuse-case audit
